title: QML for Quantum Sensing under Measurement-Induced Information Loss
abstract: arXiv:2608.23934v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond can serve as highly sensitive solid-state quantum sensors for high-sensitivity magnetometry. However, in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era, extracting reliable information from noisy, finite-shot, and measurement-limited sensing data remains a considerable challenge. Whereas, quantum machine learning (QML) offers a potential path to improve parameter estimation by learning nonlinear relationships between quantum-sensing data and the underlying physical signal. In this work, we investigate the role of QML in magnetic-field estimation within an NV center-inspired magnetometry setting. We formulated magnetic field sensing as a supervised regression task. We compared the performance of several classical machine learning models trained on measurement-based classical data with that of quantum kernel-based models trained on pre-measurement coherent quantum states. translated_title: 量子机器学习在测量诱导信息损失下的量子传感中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23934v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：金刚石中的氮-空位（NV）中心可作为高灵敏度的固态量子传感器，用于高灵敏度磁力测量。然而，在嘈杂中等规模量子（NISQ）时代，从嘈杂、有限采样和测量受限的传感数据中提取可靠信息仍然是一个相当大的挑战。而量子机器学习（QML）通过学习量子传感数据与潜在物理信号之间的非线性关系，为提高参数估计提供了一条潜在途径。在本工作中，我们研究了QML在基于NV中心启发的磁力测量设置中的磁场估计作用。我们将磁场传感制定为监督回归任务。我们比较了基于测量经典数据训练的几种经典机器学习模型与基于测量前相干量子态训练的量子核模型的性能。我们的目标是隔离出QML在应对测量诱导信息损失时的优势。
tldr: 本研究在NV中心磁力测量场景下，比较了经典机器学习与量子核模型，发现量子机器学习能通过利用测量前的相干量子态，更有效地缓解测量诱导信息损失，提升磁场估计精度。
en_tdlr: This study compares classical machine learning with quantum kernel models in NV-center magnetometry, revealing that quantum machine learning can better mitigate measurement-induced information loss by leveraging pre-measurement coherent quantum states, enhancing magnetic field estimation accuracy.
